title: Wikiddle - Daily Wikipedia Puzzle: Follow the Links, Find the Article
description: Every day, a new mystery Wikipedia article to find. Make guesses, follow the shared links, fall down the Wikipedia rabbit hole, and track down the answer.
target_info_label: Known information about the mystery article
target_placeholder: Common links and categories will appear here.
no_common_info: No common link or category with mystery article.
howto_text_before:
Every day, a random Wikipedia article is chosen as the mystery article. Your goal is to find it.

Every Wikipedia article contains links to other articles and belongs to categories. When you guess an article, the game shows you the links and categories it has in common with the mystery article. Use them to narrow down the mystery article.

Here's an example game in progress, after 3 guesses:
howto_text_after:
If you're stuck, hit the hint button: to reveal a random link or category from the mystery article.

Wikipedia is full of niche articles and we love it for that, but to make the game actually playable, a large number of filters were crafted. So if you're typing an article title and don't see it in the suggestions, it simply means that it can't be a mystery article.

There's no guess limit and no timer: explore Wikipedia freely and enjoy yourself.
howto_annotation_last_guess: Your most recent guess always appears here, at the top of the list.
howto_annotation_mystery: This card represents the mystery article. Its title stays hidden until you find it. Every time you make a guess, the links and categories it has in common with the mystery article are added here.
howto_annotation_previous_guesses:
The score next to each guess is the number of links in common with the mystery article. Guesses are sorted by score: the higher, the closer.
Common categories appear below the links in yellow.
A blue title means the guess is itself a link on the mystery article.
midnight_message: Midnight has passed and the daily mystery article has changed. Unfortunately your current game can't continue. Ready for today's article?
error_message: Something went wrong. Please try again.
all_hints_found_error: You already have all the hints!
all_links_found: You have found all the links...!
